viewpoint: side view, two people facing inward
layout_notes: action lives in the middle of the frame; both start near the outer thirds on the ground, converge and rise to the top-middle for the clap, then land slightly wider than start; one shared ground line across the bottom

parts.name: left_head
parts.notes: same size on every key, faces right

parts.name: left_torso
parts.notes: leans into the jump on clap key

parts.name: left_front_arm
parts.notes: reaches up and inward for the clap

parts.name: left_front_leg
parts.notes: running step then tucks in air

parts.name: right_head
parts.notes: same size as left_head, faces left

parts.name: right_torso
parts.notes: leans into the jump on clap key

parts.name: right_front_arm
parts.notes: reaches up and inward, palm meets left palm at contact

parts.name: right_front_leg
parts.notes: running step then tucks in air

parts.name: ground
parts.notes: one shared ground line, identical points on every key

keys.name: start
keys.left: on ground, mid running step toward center, front arm swinging up, hand still low and apart
keys.right: mirror of left, mid running step toward center, front arm swinging up, hand apart
keys.notes: both planted on the shared ground, bodies leaning inward, ready to push off

keys.name: clap
keys.left: fully airborne at peak of jump, both feet off ground, front arm fully extended up and inward, palm at center-top
keys.right: mirror of left, airborne at same height, front arm extended up and inward, palm meeting left palm
keys.notes: topology change: palms touch at center-top; heads and torsos clearly above the ground line; legs tucked

keys.name: end
keys.left: landed on ground, slightly farther left than start, arms settling down, knees bent from impact
keys.right: mirror of left, landed slightly farther right than start, arms settling, knees bent
keys.notes: both feet back on the shared ground, wider stance than start, contact broken

gaps.why: out of the clap, similar speed
